description: Deterministic synthetic industrial telemetry event contract for local streaming and data-engineering preparation. These events are not real industrial telemetry, not manufacturer telemetry, not UCI AI4I data, and not physically validated equipment simulation.

event_id.description: Deterministic UUID5 derived from schema version, machine code, sequence number, and event timestamp.

machine_code.description: Stable fictional machine identifier aligned with the existing operational fleet identifier range.

sequence_number.constraints: positive; starts at 1 and increases by 1 per machine within a simulation

event_time.format: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp ending with Z

source.description: Event source identifier for generated telemetry.

product_quality_type.description: Simulator-only synthetic quality category designed for a future explicit adapter to the AI4I Type feature. It is not the operational machine_type.

process_temperature_k.description: Synthetic process temperature observation. Simulator invariant keeps it above air temperature.

tool_wear_min.description: Synthetic accumulated tool wear. It never decreases within a simulation.

vibration_mm_s.description: Additional synthetic vibration observation for future streaming analytics and anomaly detection.

pressure_bar.description: Additional synthetic pressure observation for future streaming analytics and anomaly detection.

notes: The simulator does not query PostgreSQL in this phase.
Kafka, Spark, model inference, anomaly labels, and database writes are planned future work.
